inventoryAndPrices.status: LBMA page says historical tables moved to MyLBMA Portal and relevant IBA licence required. Gold auctions start London 10:30 and 15:00; final publication time depends on auction completion. IBA current licensing page distinguishes real-time, four-hour intraday, and midnight London delayed availability. Four-hour delayed end-user fee exemption does not exempt all usage/redistribution licences.
inventoryAndPrices.recommendation: Replace old undocumented JSON as intended primary with authorised IBA or licensed redistribution delivery. Portal is official validation access. Do not represent public chart endpoint as a guaranteed free commercial API; do not use COMEX futures as London spot.

inventoryAndPrices.status: Au99.99 daily closing price remains valid for current defined indicator. Shanghai Gold Benchmark is separate official auction series, not interchangeable; its auction times are 10:15 and 14:15 Beijing per SGE official rules.
inventoryAndPrices.recommendation: Keep current daily close definition unless entire indicator and its history are deliberately redefined.

inventoryAndPrices.status: ECB publishes EUR-based USD and CNY reference rates around 16:00 CET on working days excluding TARGET closures; underlying concertation normally around 14:10 CET. CNY per USD is CNY-per-EUR divided by USD-per-EUR. CFETS/PBOC central parity is different morning fixing, not a live executable price. SAFE republishes central parity rather than independent real-time FX.
inventoryAndPrices.recommendation: ECB remains sound for same-day indicative cross-market comparison. Domestic central parity can be separately labelled sensitivity/alternative-rate calculation, never silent failover. Need a licensed timestamp-matched spot FX source for truly synchronous premium.

inventoryAndPrices.status: Current page published 5 October 2026, data through 2 October 2026. Daily observations updated weekly; displayed chart is five-day rolling average. Chinese method uses Shanghai benchmark PM versus LBMA AM since April 2016 and may carry forward holidays; differs from project Au99.99 close / LBMA PM / no date mixing. Older method PDF says monthly but current page schedule says weekly.
inventoryAndPrices.licensingStatus: WGC allows personal non-commercial save/display/print; commercial use, scraping, publishing and derivatives require prior written authorisation. WGC's IBA permission does not grant onward reuse; its LBMA data only for internal review of WGC analysis.
inventoryAndPrices.recommendation: Industry processed reference for authorised/manual cross-check, not an unlicensed drop-in primary or daily same-metric fallback. XLSX numerical rows and direct download were not verified.
